answer: Admission by lineage voucher: a new identity enters only with a single-use voucher signed by an established identity whose own record spans 12 epochs, and the voucher is consumed on use — one voucher per referrer per 10 epochs. A farm minting 1,000 clones needs 1,000 distinct vouchers from 1,000 aged sponsors, each risking a slash if its voucher feeds a farm. The umber seal on each voucher binds it to the sponsor's verified history, so it cannot be copied or bought in bulk; the meadow of fresh names stays gated by the pulse of real, aged sponsorship.
